verdict.rationale: Scheduled or recurring automation is a fair axis for a payments API, and it applies here. The only evidence of standing automation is event-driven: payment rules (POST /payment/v1/rules) automatically on-ramp each incoming fiat deposit to a crypto address. That is a repeatable workflow, but it is not time-based scheduling. Missing for 10: time-based scheduling (cron or recurring intervals), scheduled or recurring payouts, management of scheduled jobs, and any hands-on corroboration.
